photos.c: Belgrave's second placed team in the Crawley Road Relay. Left to Right: John Stowe, Richard Langley, Pat Breslin and Bill Curtin.
BILL CURTIN (11) gets up with his rival M. Fromant (105) just after the start of the County Championship. JOHN STOWE, EDMUND GODFREY and PETER CARTON follow up behind No.12.
TONY BINDA takes over from JOHN STOWE for the third stage of the Mitcham Young Athletes Relay at Morden Park.

It's 14th February 1970 and Tony Binda takes over from John Stowe at the start of stage three of the Mitcham Young Athletes Relay in Morden Park.  Belgrave placed 5th.  Tony is still picking up Surrey County medals 28 years later.  How does he look today?  See centre pages
